name: ballerina/uuid
description: This module provides APIs to generate and inspect UUIDs (Universally Unique Identifiers).
readme:
## Overview

This module provides APIs to generate and inspect UUIDs (Universally Unique Identifiers).

The UUIDs are generated based on the [RFC 4122](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4122.html) standard. This module supports generating 4 versions of UUIDs.

### Version 1

Generated using the MAC address of the computer and the time of generation.

### Version 3

Cryptographic hashing and application-provided text strings are used to generate a UUID. MD5 hashing is used.

### Version 4

Uses a pseudo-random number generator to generate the UUID. Every bit of the string is randomly generated.

### Version 5

Similar to Version 3 but uses SHA-1 instead of MD5.

Other operations include validating a given UUID string and getting the version of a UUID string.

For information on the operations, which you can perform with the `uuid` module, see the below **Functions**.

fields.name: timeLow
fields.description: The low field of the timestamp

fields.name: timeMid
fields.description: The middle field of the timestamp

fields.name: timeHiAndVersion
fields.description: The high field of the timestamp multiplexed with the version number

fields.name: clockSeqHiAndReserved
fields.description: The high field of the clock sequence multiplexed with the variant

fields.name: clockSeqLo
fields.description: The low field of the clock sequence

typeDefs.name: NamespaceUUID
typeDefs.description: Represents UUIDs strings of well known namespace IDs.

functions.name: createType1AsString
functions.description:
Returns a UUID of type 1 as a string.
```ballerina
string uuid1 = uuid:createType1AsString();
```

return.description: UUID of type 1 as a string

functions.name: createType1AsRecord
functions.description:
Returns a UUID of type 1 as a UUID record.
```ballerina
uuid:Uuid uuid1 = check uuid:createType1AsRecord();
```

return.description: UUID of type 1 as a UUID record, or else a `uuid:Error`

functions.name: createType3AsString
functions.description:
Returns a UUID of type 3 as a string.
```ballerina
string uuid3 = check uuid:createType3AsString(uuid:NAME_SPACE_DNS, “ballerina.io”);
```

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: String representation for a pre-defined namespace UUID

return.description: UUID of type 3 as a string, or else a `uuid:Error`

functions.name: createType3AsRecord
functions.description:
Returns a UUID of type 3 as a UUID record.
```ballerina
uuid:Uuid uuid3 = check uuid:createType3AsRecord(uuid:NAME_SPACE_DNS, “ballerina.io”);
```

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: String representation for a pre-defined namespace UUID

return.description: UUID of type 3 as a UUID record, or else a `uuid:Error`

functions.name: createRandomUuid
functions.description:
Returns a UUID of type 4 as a string.
This function provides a convenient alias for 'createType4AsString()'.
```ballerina
string newUUID = uuid:createRandomUuid();
```

return.description: UUID of type 4 as a string

functions.name: nilAsString
functions.description:
Returns a nil UUID as a string.
```ballerina
string nilUUID = uuid:nilAsString();
```

functions.name: nilAsRecord
functions.description:
Returns a nil UUID as a UUID record.
```ballerina
uuid:Uuid nilUUID = uuid:nilAsRecord();
```

functions.name: validate
functions.description:
Test a string to see if it is a valid UUID.
```ballerina
boolean valid = uuid:validate("4397465e-35f9-11eb-adc1-0242ac120002");
```

return.description: true if a valied UUID, false if not

functions.name: getVersion
functions.description:
Detect RFC version of a UUID. Returns an error if the UUID is invalid.
```ballerina
uuid:Version v = check uuid:getVersion("4397465e-35f9-11eb-adc1-0242ac120002");
```

functions.name: toBytes
functions.description:
Converts to an array of bytes. Returns an error if the UUID is invalid.
```ballerina
byte[] b = check uuid:toBytes(“6ec0bd7f-11c0-43da-975e-2aesass0b”);
```

return.description: UUID as bytes, or else a `uuid:Error`

functions.name: toString
functions.description:
Converts to a UUID string. Returns an error if the UUID is invalid.
```ballerina
string s = check uuid:toString([5, 12, 16, 35]);
```

return.description: UUID as string, or else a `uuid:Error`

functions.name: toRecord

return.description: UUID as record, or else a `uuid:Error`
